about: Shared cases for 'is this thread asking this assistant for something, and which comment is the request?'. Run against WorkFlow's Swift rules (AgentRules.swift, for Claude on the Mac) and the companion's JavaScript (for a companion). 'by' is person, self (the assistant itself), or another assistant's name. 'trigger' is the index of the comment that is the current request, or null when the thread isn't asking. A new trigger is what wakes the assistant; the same trigger again wakes nothing.

cases.name: a person's @mention asks
a person's @mention still counts two comments later
a person's @mention older than the last three comments has lapsed
mentions are whole words: @Jarvis2 isn't Jarvis
mentions ignore case
an email address isn't a mention
another assistant's @mention asks when it's the newest comment
comments: @Jarvis please renew it on the server

cases.name: another assistant's @mention lapses once something follows it
an assistant never asks itself
three hand-offs in a row are allowed
the fourth hand-off in a row is refused (no loops)
a person writing again resets the hand-off count
the newest request wins over an older person's @mention
nothing in a shared project asks
assigned, no comments yet: assigned but no request comment
assigned: a person's comment is a follow-up
assigned: another assistant's FYI is not a request
assigned: another assistant's @mention is a request (1.6.2)
assigned: its own reply doesn't change the request
assigned in a shared project: nothing asks
